summary: Frontend-only test of the /design-preview milestone (6 routes) on the public URL, using Playwright at 1440/1024/768/390/320. Working: index (page-title, 6 screen cards linking to all routes incl. family?theme=dark, tokens/type/components/responsive cards, demo dialog opens and closes with Escape and X). Preview bar with synthetic label on every route. Data-state select gives loading/empty/error on platform, center, therapist, child and family, and Retry returns to populated. Typeface select switches h1 to Plus Jakarta Sans (body stays Plex) and survives reload. Platform: 4 metrics; Pending(2)/Decided(2) tabs filter rows (app-1,2 / app-3,4); Review opens application-dialog with disabled Approve/Reject and their reasons; event filters work (application e1,e4,e6 / center e2,e5,e7 / access e3 / all 7). Center: trial banner; meters 27/30, 3/3, Children 1/1 'Planned'; onboarding 4 of 5; staff list; Resend notice; Revoke dialog Cancel/Confirm; confirm shows 'nothing was revoked' and Hana stays Pending, so no false success. Therapist: Speech by default shows a1,a3,a5, OT shows a2,a4,a6, All shows 6; context line ends '<specialty> workspace'; clicking an appointment updates the detail panel; open-child-workspace goes to /child?specialty=ot|speech and the select matches; list/timeline toggle works. Child: 10 tabs; arrow keys move focus and selection, with wrap; Progress shows insufficient-data; Plans/Reports Sign and Release are disabled with reasons; Evidence empty state; Access shows access-denied-example; ?specialty=ot is honored. Family: light by default; toggle gives dark (#0D1226 = rgb 13,18,38), which survives reload; ?theme=dark opens dark; scenario 'today' shows no-release-state; Start activity opens the dialog, and each outcome button closes it with an 'Nothing was recorded' notice; day chips can be selected and update day-detail; at 390 week-list-mobile shows 5 stacked cards. Shell: sidebar collapses and expands 254<->76 at 1440; starts as a 76px rail at 1024; nav items without pages show preview-notice and stay on the page; notifications and account popovers close on Escape; at 390 bottom-nav has 4 items + More, the more-sheet opens, closes with Escape, and its items show a notice. No console errors on any route. No horizontal overflow at 390/768/1024/1440 on any route. Defects: horizontal overflow at 320 on every route (preview bar), notifications popover clipped off-screen at 320, family-dark contrast failure for outcome labels, activity-dialog steps don't match the activity title, and an inverted-looking selected state on the Timeline/List toggle.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320px the page overflows horizontally on every route: document.scrollWidth=348 > 320. The 'Data' + 'Type' select group (div.flex.items-center.gap-3.md:ml-auto) can't wrap and is 348px wide, and the Type select is visibly cut off. Fix: let that div wrap (flex-wrap, w-full / min-w-0), shorten or shrink the selects on small screens (e.g. max-w-[140px]), or stack the two labels.

At 320px notifications-panel renders at x=-38 (288px wide, absolute right-0 anchored to the bell, which isn't the right-most button), so its left edge is clipped off-screen. The account panel is fine (x=16). Fix: on mobile, anchor to the viewport (fixed inset-x-4) or use w-[min(18rem,calc(100vw-32px))] plus right offset.

The dialog title follows today's activity (e.g. 'Picture talk' on Tuesday), but the body always shows the activitySteps for Bubble breaths ('hold a bubble wand...'). Title and instructions contradict each other. Steps need to be per-activity, or the copy should be generic.

On a weekend every activity day is in the past, so next is undefined. The card then shows the 'Next activity' pill, 'A restful day', '0 minutes' and a live Start activity button that opens a dialog titled 'Activity' with Bubble breaths steps. A rest-day state should replace it.

issues: Outcome labels on day chips and mobile week cards use the light-theme status colors: 'Done' is text-status-success #146A50 on #1C2342, contrast 2.34:1 (fails AA). 'Needs help' (#945900) and 'Skipped' would fail the same way. Add dark-theme status tokens (lighter green/amber).

The Timeline/List toggle's selected state looks inverted. The selected button uses the 'secondary' style (white, bordered, dark text) and the unselected one uses 'ghost' (blue action text), so the unselected option looks active. The specialty switcher next to it uses a solid blue fill for selected. Use one selected style (e.g. tinted bg + action text) for both.
At 390px the specialty switcher scrolls sideways and 'All specialties' is cut off to a single 'A' with no scroll cue.

With Data=Empty, the lists show empty states but the metrics still read 'Pending applications 2', the tabs still say Pending (2)/Decided (2), and the trial-alert still says 'Cedar Grove's trial ends in 3 days' next to 'No centers on trial'. This contradicts the empty demo. Hide the alert and zero or skeleton the counts per state.
A preview-notice that is still showing (z-50) sits on top of the open More sheet (z-40) and covers its items. The sheet has role=dialog aria-modal but doesn't move or trap focus.
The tab strip scrolls sideways at 768 and 320 with no fade or chevron cue. Tabs don't support Home/End keys and have no aria-controls/id link to the tabpanel.
On mobile the activity-dialog footer wraps 'Needs help' onto a second, right-aligned line. Consider full-width stacked buttons.

action_items: Fix 320px horizontal overflow from the preview bar's Data/Type select group (all routes)
Keep notifications-panel inside the viewport on small screens
Add per-activity steps to the family activity dialog, or genericize them; handle the weekend 'no upcoming activity' case
Add family-dark variants for status colors (Done/Needs help/Skipped) to meet 4.5:1
Make the Timeline/List toggle's selected state match the specialty switcher (selected should look selected)

Optional: make Platform counts and trial-alert follow Data=Empty/Loading; add scroll cues to horizontally scrolling tab and switcher strips; z-order the notice under the sheet or dismiss it when the sheet opens
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid: therapist appointment-{id} is rendered twice (list ul, hidden md+, and timeline), so tests need :visible. Consider separate ids (appointment-list-a1 / appointment-tl-a1).
AppShell sets collapsed and theme in useEffect after the first render, so 1024px and dark-theme loads briefly flash the expanded/light layout.

The Data state lives in the layout-level PreviewProvider and persists across route navigation (e.g. Empty set on Center is still active on Therapist). That's fine for the demo but could confuse reviewers; consider resetting it on route change or showing it more prominently.
notify() uses setNotice with an identical string, so a repeated identical message doesn't restart the 3.8s timer.
Child 'Working as' select only changes the select. Nothing in the tabs filters by specialty (acceptable for a preview, but worth labeling).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested interactions pass; 320px overflow requirement fails on all routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Base: https://therabridge.preview.emergentagent.com/design-preview. Overflow check: document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs viewport at 320/390/768/1024/1440 for '', /platform, /center, /therapist, /child, /family, /family?theme=dark. Only 320 failed (348, preview bar). Use '[data-testid=appointment-aN]:visible' on therapist. LocalStorage keys: tb-family-theme, tb-preview-typeface. The family dialog title depends on the weekday (week computed from today's date).
